g.title: communication01
g.text: Communication 01: final transcript segment -> question detected (Candidate mode; Workplace branch 3.17-3.19)

g.title: note
g.text: The question is accepted when confidence >= assistant.detection_threshold.
Action::Answer is queued only when the meeting is Active, mode == Candidate,
Workplace (3.4, 3.17-3.19): action items and decisions go to the board, not to
rt.action_items (3.4 extends rt.action_items only in Candidate and Interviewer mode).
In Workplace mode Action::Answer(q) is queued only for a question from someone else
that is addressed to the user (addressed_to_listener), not for every question.
Persists / events for claims, action items and topics are otherwise omitted here.
